caseNameFull: Manton v. United States and Spector v. Same
attorneys: Messrs. William E. Leahy and William J. Hughes, Jr. for petitioner in No. 645., Mr. Harry E. Ratner for petitioner in No. 646., Solicitor General Biddle, Assistant Attorney .General Rogge, and Messrs. John T. Cahill, William W. Barron, George F. Kneip, and W. opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Stone and Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration and decision of these applications.
